title: Evaluate an arithmetic expression string
description: Implement eval_expression(expression). Evaluate a string containing non-negative integers, the binary operators + - * /, parentheses, and unary minus, with standard precedence (* and / before + and -) and left associativity. Whitespace may appear anywhere and is ignored. Division is true division. Return the result as an int when it is a whole number, otherwise as a float. Raise ValueError on empty or malformed input and on division by zero.
invariants: Unary minus binds tighter than binary operators: '2*-3' evaluates to -6 and '3--2' to 5.
Whitespace is ignored anywhere, including inside multi-digit numbers is NOT allowed to change the number: '1 2' is invalid (two adjacent numbers are malformed input).
Implicit multiplication is not supported: '2(3)' raises ValueError.
ValueError on: empty string, trailing operator ('2+'), unbalanced parentheses, unknown characters, division by zero.
